intentComment: Story 056 — cut index-4 dispatcher over to a Sky-PSM BalancerPoolerV2 + new MintDebtHook (migrate BPT+sUSDS, manual Sky-route validation, final pool())

dry.note: PREVIEW_MODE=true -> run() takes the vm.startPrank(OWNER_ADDRESS) branch (impersonate owner), no broadcast. No node pre/post scripts.

broadcast.note: PREVIEW_MODE unset -> isPreview=false -> run() takes vm.startBroadcast() branch (ledger-signed). --skip-simulation is required because the final pool() relies on offline-derived minBPT and Balancer V3 query gating; the script self-guards with internal require/asserts instead of forge simulation.

pre.mutates: none — copy-only snapshot of mainnet-addresses.ts before the cutover

mutates: nftsV2.BalancerPooler: expected OLD 0x26f89f4b46eb164303985795ee20b15bb1edb38a (LIVE_INDEX4_POOLER) -> newPooler (BalancerPoolerV2 CREATE from broadcast)
BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook: expected OLD 0x14277a0bc38a6bb7eb732c3a49190030632f727e -> newHook (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook CREATE from broadcast)
refreshes the '// Updated <date>: index-4 dispatcher cut over to Sky-PSM ...' header comment
post.selfValidating: Refuses to patch (exit 3) unless the current on-file address matches the expected-OLD constant; requires exactly 2 CREATE txs (BalancerPoolerV2 + BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook). Exit 1 if broadcast run-latest.json missing/unparseable, 2 if a contract CREATE not found, 4 if mainnet-addresses.ts missing.

chainIdNote: setUp() requires block.chainid == 1 (Mainnet) || 31337 (Anvil fork). pool() enforces minBPT>0 on chainid!=31337; relaxes minBPT to 1 only on 31337.
